reasoning_input.question_text: Solve 2x² - 8x + 3 = 0 by completing the square. Give your answers in surd form.

steps.description: Write the equation in standard form
Divide through by leading coefficient to make x² coefficient = 1
Rearrange so constant is on RHS
Complete the square by adding (half of x-coefficient)² to both sides
Take square root of both sides including ±
State both solutions in surd/simplified form
